functions.recoveredRole: Deletes selected user-defined curve definitions and refreshes the Add Curve dialog catalog
functions.behavior: Scans every AvailableCurvesLB row, clears an unnamed flag on each selected curve object, removes matching named definitions from the active application collection and runtime curve catalog, rebuilds the internal candidate catalog, requests application refreshes, and rebuilds the filtered available list. Zero selections skip deletion but still run the refresh path.
functions.evidence: The DFM binds DeleteBtn.OnClick to 013cf920. The recovered handler reads AvailableCurvesLB.Items.Count, Selected[index], item objects, and item text; calls FUN_019ae710 and FUN_013c5ac0 with each selected name; then calls FUN_00f1e090, FUN_013ca610, and FUN_013cab80. No confirmation-dialog call is present.

functions.recoveredRole: Removes a named user-defined curve from a runtime curve catalog
functions.behavior: Uses an exact name lookup in the catalog at model offset 0x300. If a record exists, it removes the record from the backing collection and destroys it. A missing name is a no-op.
functions.evidence: FUN_013c5ac0 calls FUN_00f211b0 with the supplied name, removes the returned record from the catalog backing list, and passes the same record to the Delphi object destruction helper. DeleteBtnClick supplies its dialog model and each selected list item name.

functions.recoveredRole: Removes a named curve definition from the active application curve collection
functions.behavior: Finds a curve record by name in the active collection, removes the matching record from the collection, and destroys it. A missing name is a no-op.
functions.evidence: FUN_019ae710 calls the collection-specific name lookup FUN_019ae650, removes a non-null result from the collection at offset 0x1f0, and destroys it. DeleteBtnClick gets the active owner through FUN_019a45d0 and supplies each selected curve name. The paired curve creation routines add or update records in this same collection.

functions.recoveredRole: Collects current global curve and source entries into a supplied catalog list
functions.behavior: Refreshes two cached source handles and appends entries from the current application curve and source registries to the supplied list.
functions.evidence: FUN_00f1e090 refreshes DAT_0202eb40 and DAT_0202eb48, then repeatedly calls FUN_00f1df90 with the supplied list and the available global source pointers. DeleteBtnClick uses the result to rebuild the dialog's internal candidate catalog.

functions.recoveredRole: Replaces the Add Curve dialog internal candidate catalog from a supplied list
functions.behavior: Clears the internal candidate collection, then copies every supplied item text and attached object reference into it in source order.
functions.evidence: FUN_013ca610 clears the collection at form offset 0x878, iterates the supplied list count, reads each item text and object, and adds both to that form collection. DeleteBtnClick calls it with the list populated by FUN_00f1e090.

functions.recoveredRole: Rebuilds the Add Curve dialog filtered available-curve list
functions.behavior: Clears AvailableCurvesLB, scans the internal candidate catalog, excludes objects already present in CurveToInsertLB, applies the current category and text filters, and adds accepted item text and object references to the visible list.
functions.evidence: FUN_013cab80 clears the Items collection at form offset 0x778, iterates the candidate collection at 0x878, tests attached objects against CurveToInsertLB at 0x7e0 and filter controls, and adds accepted text and objects to AvailableCurvesLB. DeleteBtnClick calls it after catalog rebuild and application refresh calls.
